acorus-gramineus.name: Acorus gramineus
notes: Section 4: "starting from 80 liters (20 gallons)" -> "bermula dari 80 liter" is fine; but "Hujung daun kering" etc fine. Real issue: Section 8 "nimfa pepatung, nimfa pepatung jarum" - 'dragonfly, damselfly nymphs' is OK, but 'Hydrogen sulfide' fine.
Section 1/8: "Boleh ditanam secara emersed" and "bentuk emergen" are inconsistent; use one term, e.g. "tumbuh timbul (emersed)".

Section 8: "Tumbuhan ini suka pencahayaan yang baik" under heading "Cahaya tidak mencukupi" is fine, but "tanah lembap" for 'wetlands' in section 3 is imprecise; use "tanah bencah/lembap" and "(sebahagiannya atau sepenuhnya tenggelam)" fine.
Section 3: "di paya" for marshes is acceptable; "kawasan tanah lembap" better "kawasan tanah bencah".
Section 8: "Daunnya mengeluarkan bau wangi yang ketara apabila dironyok" - 'dironyok' is awkward; use "diramas".
Section 7: "low-tech" left in English; use "tangki berteknologi rendah (low-tech)".
Section 8: "Kuarantin ... nyahjangkit" fine; "Mencegah poket gas" fine; "Bentuk ini biasa digunakan di sempadan taman" ok.

aegagropila-linnaei.name: Marimo
notes: Item 3: 8 to 12 inches converted to "20 hingga 30 cm" is fine, so no change needed there. The real problems are elsewhere.
Item 5: "Ia tumbuh sangat perlahan, iaitu 5 mm setahun" - correct, but "Kebanyakan marimo yang dijual di pasaran" is fine. Not an error.

Item 4: "Haiwan pembersih ... pandai mengutip" - "pandai" is colloquial; use "mampu" or "cekap" instead. The mix of "moss ball" and "bola marimo" is inconsistent; use one term ("bola marimo") throughout.
Item 4: "Pusingkan sekali-sekala" omits the object; use "Pusingkan bola itu sekali-sekala".
Item 4: "Kalau ia mula mengumpul kotoran" - "detritus" is better translated as "detritus" or "sisa organik" than "kotoran".

Item 6: Latin name changed. The English has "Cladophora aegagrophila" in the second mention, and the MS keeps it. That is faithful to the source. However, the source's spelling inconsistency is carried over; consider unifying to "Cladophora aegagropila".
Item 6: "mesti dielakkan walau apa pun" - better: "alga perlu dielakkan sebaik mungkin".

Item 7: "Peminat aquascape pernah membukanya menjadi hamparan" - "membukanya" is unclear; use "menguraikannya" or "melerai gulungannya". Also "hiasan" is repeated in "balang hiasan sebagai hiasan rumah"; reword.

alternanthera-bettzickiana.name: Alternanthera bettzickiana
notes: Section 3: 'mesh areas' was rendered as 'kawasan paya' (swamp area). The source word is probably a garbled 'marsh', so check it, but the rendering is still a meaning shift. Make it consistent with the source or flag it.

Section 4: 'growth is then moderate to high' was rendered as 'sederhana hingga cepat'. Use 'sederhana hingga tinggi' or 'sederhana hingga pesat' to match the source and the header's 'Kadar pertumbuhan'.

Section 1: 'Growth rate: low' became 'perlahan', which is fine. However, 'Boleh ditanam secara emersed' and 'Pembiakan' leave 'emersed' in English with no local gloss. Use 'secara emers (di atas air)' or 'tumbuh separa darat' for readability.

Section 4: 'In winter it can only survive indoors' was kept as 'Pada musim sejuk'. Malaysia has no winter, so add context such as 'di negara beriklim sederhana' or rephrase for local readers. The 'south-facing window' advice also does not suit Malaysia.
Section 4: 'daun udara' for 'aerial leaves' is awkward. Use 'daun emers' or 'daun yang tumbuh di atas permukaan air'.

Section 4: 'Hardness 1–12 GH' was rendered as 'Kekerasan air 1–12 GH'. This is acceptable, but 'melting' left in English in brackets is fine. 'Substrat ... kedalaman' is fine. 'Gastrousus' in section 1 is non-standard. Use 'penyakit gastrousus' or 'penyakit saluran penghadaman'.
Section 1: 'prophylaxis of dementia' was rendered as 'pencegahan demensia'. This is fine, but 'sebagai sumber khasiat' for 'for nourishment' is slightly off. Use 'sebagai makanan berkhasiat/tonik'.

alternanthera-reineckii.name: Alternanthera reineckii
notes: Item 7: 'Cucuk batang baharu itu ke dalam substrat' – 'cucuk' is slightly odd; use 'tanam' or 'tancapkan'.
Item 7: 'Jika tumbuhan menerima semua keperluan yang diperlukan' is redundant; use 'semua sumber yang diperlukan'.
Item 8: 'melting (cair)' mixes English and Malay; keep one form consistently, e.g. 'mereput/cair (melting)'.
Item 2: 'secara emersed' is left in English; add the Malay term 'timbul/di atas air' (emersed).
Item 12: 'Jambak bunganya terletak pada ketiak' is stiff; 'Perbungaan tumbuh di ketiak daun' is more natural.
Item 9: 'Baja yang berlebihan, paling ringan pun' is awkward; use 'sekurang-kurangnya/paling minimum'.
Item 12: 'Kurang tahan lasak' for 'Not very resilient' is acceptable but the following sentence 'tidak mampu menyerap logam berat tanpa terjejas' is slightly stiff.

alternanthera-reineckii-mini.name: Alternanthera reineckii 'Mini'
notes: "Tumbuhan batang" for Type: Stem is acceptable, but "Tumbuhan akuatik" for "Aquarium plant" drops the aquarium sense; use "Tumbuhan akuarium".
"tumbuh padat dan lebih perlahan" is awkward; use "pertumbuhan yang padat dan kadar pertumbuhan yang lebih perlahan".
"memperbaik" is non-standard; use "memperbaiki" or "meningkatkan".
"Cahaya yang tinggi" is imprecise; use "keamatan cahaya yang tinggi".
"latar depan" is better as "latar hadapan" (foreground); "aquascape" could be given as "akuaskap" or kept in italics.
"hamparan merah keunguan" for "carpet" is acceptable, but "permaidani" or "hamparan padat" is the more common hobby term.

ammannia-crassicaulis.name: Ammannia crassicaulis
notes: Item 3: "8-15 cm wide" refers to the plant/leaf rosette width, and "lebar 8-15 cm" after "Batangnya" implies the stem is 8-15 cm wide; clarify that the plant (not the stem) is 8-15 cm wide, e.g. "dengan lebar tumbuhan 8-15 cm".
Item 2: "ke dalam substrat" is fine, but "daun tersebut akan mati" could be more natural as "daun itu akan mati" or "layu dan mati" (minor).
Item 3: "tumbuhan akuatik ... untuk akuarium" is slightly redundant; "tumbuhan akuarium" is the usual hobby term (minor).
Item 3: "seperti warna koniak" is awkward; consider "berwarna koniak" or "merah keperangan seperti koniak" (minor).

ammannia-gracilis.name: Ammannia gracilis
notes: Minor: "ferum" is stiff for hobbyists; "besi" (iron) is more common in fertiliser talk.
Minor: "Kerana saiznya, peliharalah dalam tangki..." reads abruptly; a smoother version would be "Disebabkan saiznya, tanamlah dalam tangki yang bersaiz sesuai".

anubias-barteri.name: Anubias Coin Leaf
notes: "tangki" is acceptable, but "akuarium" is the more usual term in Malaysia for "di dalam tangki"; consider "di dalam akuarium".
"penggemar akuarium" could be the more common "hobiis akuarium" or "peminat akuarium".

anubias-barteri-mini-coin.name: Anubias Mini Coin
notes: "sama mudah ditanam seperti induknya, dan oleh itu tidak suka cahaya terang": the English is itself odd, but the Malay keeps the illogical "dan oleh itu". Rephrase it to say it is as easy to grow as the parent plant and likewise dislikes bright light, e.g. "... dan seperti induknya, tidak menyukai cahaya terang".

"ditemui di nurseri tumbuhan akuarium Tropica": "found at" is ambiguous. "ditemui di" is acceptable, but "nurseri tumbuhan akuarium" adds "tumbuhan" (plant), which is not in the source. Use "nurseri akuarium Tropica" or "ditemui oleh/di Tropica".
"kuku jari kelingking" is fine, but "Anubias yang paling kecil" loses "very smallest". Use "antara Anubias yang paling kecil sekali".
"Ketinggian: 3 - 10+ cm" is fine. "Asal: kultivar" would be better as "Asal usul: kultivar" or "Jenis: kultivar".
"diikat pada batu": "attached" is better rendered as "dilekatkan/diikat", which is fine. "anak pokok baharu" for "new plants" is acceptable. "batang menjalar (rizom)" is acceptable.

anubias-barteri-nana.name: Anubias nana
notes: Item 2: "dengan sangat perlahan" renders "nhẹ tay" (gently). Use "dengan lembut" or "perlahan-lahan dan lembut"; the tension is the point, not the speed.
Item 2: the source text is Vietnamese, not English. The meaning is still fully kept.

anubias-barteri-petite.name: Anubias Petite
notes: "tangki" is acceptable, but "akuarium" is the more usual hobby term: use "akuarium" instead of "dalam tangki" in item 1 and "tangki yang lebih besar" in item 2.

"tidak cerewet dan juga tidak suka cahaya yang terlalu terang" reads awkwardly. Suggest "tidak cerewet ... dan tidak memerlukan cahaya yang terlalu terang", since the English says it does not appreciate high light intensity.
"sehingga akarnya dapat mencengkam" is fine in meaning. "Tumbuhan yang sesuai" starting the last paragraph is a fragment. Suggest "Tumbuhan ideal untuk landskap mini...".

anubias-barteri-var-barteri.name: Anubias barteri
notes: Item 1: "tangki" is acceptable, but "akuarium" is more natural for hobbyists.
Item 2: "tumbuhan akuatik" was added where the English only says "plant". This is minor and does no harm.
Item 3: "liat dan tegap" is slightly awkward for leaves. Consider "keras dan kukuh" or "tebal dan kuat".

anubias-barteri-var-caladiifolia.name: Anubias Caladiifolia
notes: "Berizom" is a bit unusual; prefer "Berakar rizom" or "Rizom" for "Rhizomatous".
"Pokok induk" is acceptable but "tumbuhan induk" is more natural; "pasu segi empat 9 cm" should be "pasu segi empat sama 9 cm".
"Daunnya boleh hidup" is slightly awkward; prefer "Daunnya tahan selama beberapa tahun".

anubias-barteri-var-coffeifolia.name: Anubias Coffeefolia
notes: "Jenis: Berizom" is acceptable, but "Asal: Kultivar" is slightly off; "Asal usul: Kultivar" would read more naturally.
"Spesies Anubias nampaknya tumbuh begitu perlahan sehingga seolah-olah tidak sedar..." is a little stiff. Consider "hingga tidak menyedari bahawa ia telah tenggelam".

anubias-barteri-var-nana.name: Anubias barteri var. nana
notes: "Cameroon" is better written "Cameroon"/"Kamerun" in standard Malay; use "Kamerun" as the Malaysian standard form.
"tumbuh subur dalam semua keadaan" is slightly overstated/unnatural; consider "boleh tumbuh dalam pelbagai keadaan".
"Ketinggian" for plant height is better as "Tinggi"; minor.
"jadi alga yang tumbuh perlahan berpeluang bertapak" is clumsy; consider "membolehkan alga yang tumbuh perlahan melekat pada daun".

anubias-barteri-var-nana-kirin.name: Anubias Nana Kirin
notes: Item 1: "tangki" is acceptable, but "akuarium" would be more consistent with item 2.
Item 3: "bujur telur" is fine, but "berbentuk bujur" or "bujur telur" alone reads more naturally. "diilhamkan daripada naga Asia" could be "diilhamkan oleh naga Asia".

anubias-barteri-var-nana-pinto.name: Anubias Nana Pinto
notes: Minor: 'Keperluan cahaya: Sederhana' is fine, but 'Sederhana' could be 'Sederhana' (ok); consider 'Anubias barteri' italicised as Latin name for consistency.
Minor: 'aquascape' could be 'aquascape' with Malay 'susun atur akuarium' in brackets for clarity.

anubias-gracilis.name: Anubias gracilis
notes: "saiznya akan menjadi agak besar": English says "significant size", so "agak besar" (fairly large) is too weak. Use "sangat besar" or "jauh lebih besar".
"jika ditanam begitu": this is a little loose. "jika dibiarkan tumbuh begitu" or "dengan cara ini" is closer to the source.

aponogeton-boivinianus.name: Aponogeton boivinianus
notes: Item 2: "Kapsul baja" for "Nutrition capsules" is acceptable, but "hujung pucuknya berada pada permukaan tanah" should be "di permukaan substrat" to stay consistent with "lapisan substrat".
Item 3: "serta lebar 30–50 cm" is awkward and unclear. The English is also odd (plant spread). Rephrase as "dan keseluruhan tumbuhan boleh mencapai lebar 30–50 cm".
Item 3: "keperangan" is non-standard. Use "keperang-perangan" or "agak keperangan".
Item 1: "bebawang (bulb)" is fine, but "Ketinggian" could be "Tinggi"; this is a minor point.

aponogeton-longiplumulosus.name: Aponogeton longiplumulosus
notes: Item 2: "Nutrition capsule" translated as "Kapsul baja"; fine in meaning but "kapsul nutrien/baja akar" is more usual. Also "substrat" and "tanah" are mixed for the same thing (bottom layer/soil surface); use one term consistently.
Item 2: "agak mudah dijaga" for "relatively undemanding" is OK, but "tidak memerlukan kualiti air yang khusus" is fine; consider "tidak cerewet" for natural phrasing.

Item 3: "fluted" rendered as "beralun" (wavy); better "bergelombang/beralun" is acceptable, but "sangat cantik dan sesuai disyorkan" is clumsy; rephrase as "tumbuhan menarik yang sesuai disyorkan untuk akuarium besar".
Item 1: "Bebawang/ubi" for "Bulb/onion" is awkward; use "Umbi/bawang" or "Umbi".

aponogeton-madagascariensis.name: Madagascar Lace Plant
notes: "Kapsul baja" – source says "Nutrition capsules"; acceptable, but "kapsul nutrien" is closer. Minor.
"tumpuan istimewa" – "speciality" is rendered as a focal point; "kegemaran istimewa/spesies istimewa" would be closer to the meaning. Minor.
"sangat cerewet" is informal for "makes such high demands"; consider "menuntut kualiti air dan substrat yang sangat tinggi". Minor.
"bottom layer" rendered as "substrat" – fine, but "saiznya dari 25 hingga 50 cm" is better as "bersaiz 25 hingga 50 cm". Minor.

aponogeton-ulvaceus.name: Aponogeton ulvaceus
notes: "Satu bebawang boleh mengeluarkan": English says "single root"; "bebawang" is acceptable but "akar"/"ubi" is more common; "ubi" (umbi) is the usual hobby term for bulb, so use "umbi" instead of "bebawang" throughout.
"Jenis: bebawang (bulb)": "umbi" is the more standard Malay term for plant bulb/tuber; "bebawang" sounds like onion-like and is less natural.
"tahan lasak" for "relatively tolerant" is slightly stronger than the original; consider "agak toleran".

bacopa-australis.name: Bacopa australis
notes: Item 2: "dasar tangki" is fine, but "akuarium" and "tangki" are mixed; consider using "dasar akuarium" for consistency (minor).

bacopa-caroliniana.name: Bacopa caroliniana
notes: "tangki" in item 1: Malaysian hobbyists usually say "akuarium" (or "tangki akuarium"); use that.
"tidak banyak kerenah": "kerenah" has a negative sense (fussiness, mischief). Use "tidak cerewet" or "tidak memerlukan penjagaan khusus".
"tidak perlu dijaga sangat" is colloquial. Use "tidak memerlukan banyak perhatian".
"tanam di dasar": use "tanam di substrat/dasar akuarium", because "dasar" alone is vague.

"lebar 3-4 cm" for stems is a literal carry-over of the English. It most likely means leaf width, but the source is ambiguous. Check the context, and consider "daun selebar 3-4 cm" if that is what is meant.
"tumbuhan batang": the usual hobby term is "tumbuhan berbatang" (stem plants). It can be kept, with "(stem plant)" in brackets.

bacopa-monnieri.name: Bacopa Monnieri Compact
notes: "tangki" in item 1: Malaysian hobbyists normally say "akuarium" for the tank; use "akuarium".
"Kultivar tumbuhan berbatang" in item 3: "culture form" is rendered as "kultivar", which is acceptable, but "tumbuhan berbatang" (stem plant) could be "tumbuhan batang" as hobbyists say it.
"Asal: kultivar": "Origin" is better as "Asal usul".

bacopa-salzmannii.name: Bacopa salzmannii 'Purple'
notes: Item 3: 'tanah lembap' for 'wetlands' is slightly imprecise; 'kawasan tanah bencah/paya' is more natural.
Item 2: 'penggemar akuarium' for 'aquarists' is fine, but 'pembiakannya pun mudah kerana hanya perlu menggunakan keratan batang' is wordy; could be simplified.
